main_text.head: ARTICVLVS XXV. De abrogatione Legis Ceremonialis: & de Convenientiâ V. & N. Testamenti.
main_text.p: CRedimus omnes Ceremonias & figuras Legis, omnes denique umbras cessasse, adventu Christi, adeò ut earum quoque usus inter Christianos jam tolli atque aboleri debeat. Interim tamen manet nobis illarum veritas & substantia in Christo, in quo omnes impletæ fuerunt. Legis verò & Prophetarum testimonijs adhuc utimur, ut nos ipsos in Evangelij doctrinâ confirmemus:{1} & omnem vitam nostram honestè ad DEI gloriam juxta ipsius voluntatem, componamus{2}
1. In V.T. nullas extare Evangelicas promissiones de vitâ æternâ: ac proinde doctrinam Evangelij non posse confirmari testimonijs Prophetarum.
A WELSINGIO, De Offic.hom. Christ.[?] fol.E.6. Septimus error Evangelicorum est, quod credant vitam æternam

page.notes: The "{1}" and "{2}" marks follow the printed superscript numerals after "confirmemus:" and "componamus"; the foot block is set in smaller type. The footnote's last word "non" stands as the catchword at the right below the text, and the note continues on the next page. The Welsingio citation reads "Christ." in the scan, with the long s form, so the word is marked as doubtful. Faint show-through of the facing page is left out.
